0022600170.text: The Golden State Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak) host the Phoenix Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) in the Warriors' eighth game of the season, with the Warriors 9th in the West and 1 game back of the Pacific lead, while the Suns sit 12th in the West. The Warriors trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after Phoenix beat them 131-122 in Phoenix on October 24, though Golden State won the 2025-26 series 3-1. Golden State is without Al Horford (rest), Brandon Williams (quadriceps bruise), Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery).
